extra.reactionTrigger: You declared the 'Rally' command

abilities.name: SOUND THE HORNS OF WAR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army). Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from charge rolls for friendly and enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: CONSTRUCTS OF WAR
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly HEROES that target an enemy HERO.

abilities.name: DESPERATE REINFORCEMENTS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: You can return D3 slain models to each friendly unit in combat.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use a RUN ability and still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: RALLY THE RESERVES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE units that have been destroyed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up replacement units more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge in friendly territory or wholly within 3" of a secure fortification.

abilities.name: THE COLUMN MARCHES ONWARDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE units that have been destroyed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up replacement units more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge in friendly territory or wholly within 3" of a seized fortification.

abilities.name: STORM THE FORTIFICATIONS
abilities.declare: Pick a secure fortification that you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that fortification is no longer secure and is seized for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: WARDS AGAINST UNDEATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 15" of a secure fortification that has no enemy units within 3" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Both players roll 2D6. If the Lethis player’s roll is higher than the Petrifex Elite player’s roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the rolls.

abilities.name: DA KING’S ADJUTANT
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: You cannot use this ability and the Bad Moon Loonshrine’s ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability in the same turn. If this unit is within 12" of a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine, pick a friendly non-reinforced, non-HERO, non-MONSTER KING’S GITZ unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: GLAREJESTER
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit within 3" of this unit and that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. Add the roll to the distance the target can move when using MOVE abilities this phase. If the target ends a move in this phase within 3" of this HERO, inflict an amount of mortal damage on this HERO equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MOON
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Moon on the battlefield, pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Moon wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: DA LOONKING’S COMMAND
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly KING’S GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by champions in the target unit.
If the target uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6.
Add 1 to the target’s control score.

abilities.name: RIGHT GITZ IN DA RIGHT PLACE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly KING’S GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target’s weapons have Anti-HERO (+1 Rend) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: DA KING’S GUARDS
abilities.effect:
While a friendly TROGGOTH unit is within the combat range of a friendly HERO:
That HERO has WARD (4+).
Each time you make a successful ward roll for that HERO, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly TROGGOTH unit within that HERO’s combat range after the damage sequence for that HERO has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: DA LOONKING’S COURT
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE KING’S GITZ HEROES that do not have an enhancement.
abilities.effect:
Give each HERO 1 enhancement from the ‘Da King’s Gitz’ Army of Renown rules.
Designer’s Note: These enhancements are given to the HEROES during the deployment phase, not during army composition.

abilities.name: THE MOON AND THE LOON
abilities.effect:
While a friendly unit is wholly within 9" of a friendly Skragrott, a friendly Malevolent Moon or a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine:
Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-SQUIG MOONCLAN units.
Instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly SQUIG unit, you can use a value of 4.

abilities.name: WOTNOT OF PRESTIGE
abilities.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: MOONHONED SHIV
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-Companion melee weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. In addition, each time this unit uses a RETREAT ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: LOONSTONE MEDALLION
abilities.effect: This unit has WARD (6+). While this unit is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units, it has WARD (5+).

abilities.name: SNATCH ’EM UP!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this Regiment of Renown’s Swampboss Skumdrekk to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: BOMBZ AWAY, LADZ!
abilities.effect: Friendly units in this Regiment of Renown can use RUN abilities and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn while they are wholly within 12" of this Regiment of Renown’s Swampboss Skumdrekk.

abilities.name: AGGRAVATE WOUNDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Sloppklaw’s Talons is 4.

abilities.name: BET-MASTER
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the bet.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit and friendly Hobgrot Slittaz units that target the bet.

abilities.name: KOUNTIN’ KREW
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Hobgrot Slittaz unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target’s Slitta-knives have Crit (Mortal) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: SCRAP-BANG
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: ECHOES OF BLIGHT CITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the Instability level. Then, reset the Instability level to 1.

abilities.name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Emerald Lifeswarm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: FIZZCAP
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use a SUMMON SPELL ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had WIZARD (1). Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 12 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound. Then, if this unit is not MOONCLAN, roll a dice. On a 1-4, 1 model in this unit is automatically slain.

abilities.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is no longer stable.

abilities.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.

abilities.name: CLING ON TIGHT
abilities.effect: Each time the Thundertusk Beastriders unit in this Regiment of Renown uses the ‘Plough the Icepath’ ability, you can pick a friendly INFANTRY unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of that Thundertusk Beastriders unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target instead of a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY unit.

abilities.name: ALONG THE ICEPATHS
abilities.declare: Pick the Huskard on Stonehorn in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick up to 3 visible friendly units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the friendly Thundertusk Beastriders unit in this Regiment of Renown is wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
Add 3 to run rolls for each target.
Each target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
Each time a target uses a RETREAT ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

abilities.name: STONE SKELETON
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves is 4.

abilities.name: PRIMAL BELLOW
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target or pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 4+:
If the target is a friendly unit, its Companion weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.
If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: PLOUGH THE ICEPATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for this unit in your movement phase
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of this unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target unit wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. The target cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for this unit in your movement phase

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks is 2.

abilities.name: CHILLING ONSLAUGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
abilities.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

abilities.name: SEARCH THE RUIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an emberstone nugget and is contesting a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone nugget. If you are the underdog, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BACK TO BASE CAMP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an emberstone nugget, was not set up this turn and is contesting a Golden Lions objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target’s emberstone nugget.

abilities.name: SPREADING WARPFIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If there are no flaming terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature that is not flaming and that is within 12" of a flaming terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is flaming for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any flaming terrain features.

abilities.name: GLITZY BITZ ROLLA
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
If this unit is a non-TROGGOTH unit, add 1 to wound rolls for its attacks for the rest of the turn.
If this unit is a TROGGOTH, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Colossal Boulder Club to 6.
Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Throwin’ Boulders to 3.
Set the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Noxious Vomit to 3.

abilities.name: EARTH-SHAKING STOMP
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy INFANTRY and CAVALRY units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: TITANIC STRIDE
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by RETREAT abilities.

warscrolls.name: Warstomper Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: DON’T STOMP THOSE, STOMP THEM!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly BIG or LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: ALMIGHTIER STOMPIN’
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D3. For the rest of the turn, add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Almighty Stomp, but all of this unit’s attacks made with that weapon must target the target unit.
If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: TITANIC BOULDERCLUB
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Titanic Boulderclub.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Titanic Boulderclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: SIMMERING RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

abilities.name: RAISING THE HEAT
abilities.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

abilities.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

abilities.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: GRIEVOUS HALITOSIS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FORTRESS WREKKA
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You delcared the ‘Rip It Up and Chuck It’ ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown
abilities.effect: After picking the target for that ability, roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the unit in this Regiment of Renown’s Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You delcared the ‘Rip It Up and Chuck It’ ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown

warscrolls.name: Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Fortcrusha Flail is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: PRIMAL RECKONING
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Fortcrusha Flail: Crushing Blow for each friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit that has been destroyed this battle, to a maximum of 10.

abilities.name: FORTCRUSHA FLAIL
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Fortcrusha Flail.

abilities.name: RIP IT UP AND CHUCK IT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit that is not uprooted, then pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+:
If the target is another BIG unit, excluding Gatebreaker Mega-Gargants, it is armed with a Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn (see the weapon profile on this unit’s warscroll. Modifiers to this unit’s ranged weapons or shooting attacks do not apply to the target).
If the target is a Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant or a LITTLE unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
That terrain feature is uprooted for the rest of the battle. If it is FACTION TERRAIN, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the rampage roll.

abilities.name: GITSPEED
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, if a friendly Bad Moon Loonshrine uses the ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability, you can set up the replacement unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units instead of wholly within 12" of that Bad Moon Loonshrine.

abilities.name: BRIGHT FRIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are contesting the target objective.

abilities.name: GAZE OF GLAREFACE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GLOOMSPITE GITZ unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an ability inflicts damage points on the target, after the ability has been resolved, the target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: COLLECT THE TITHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the GOTHIZZAR HARVESTER in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick a NON-HERO INFANTRY unit (friendly or enemy) within its combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain, then give the unit using this ability 1 bone-tithe point.

abilities.name: SOUL TAX
abilities.declare:
Pick the Mortisan Ossifector in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then:
Pick a friendly unit, excluding units in this Regiment of Renown, to be the target.
Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the recipient.
The target and the recipient must be wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
The target has a maximum control score of 1.
Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the recipient’s combat attacks.

abilities.name: REBUILD ON THE MARCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Gothizzar Harvester in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it has 6 bone-tithe points. Then, pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Reset the Gothizzar Harvester’s bone-tithe points to 0. Then, set up a replacement of the target unit with half the number of models (rounding up) wholly within 9" of the Gothizzar Harvester and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIELDS OF THE LEGION
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units within this unit’s combat range.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range

abilities.name: BONE CAGE
abilities.effect: This unit is either full or empty. It starts the battle full.

abilities.name: BONE HARVEST
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a FIGHT ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is full.

abilities.name: REPAIR CONSTRUCT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is full, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is empty.

warscrolls.name: Mortisan Ossifector
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Mortisan Vizier.

abilities.name: REFINED CREATIONS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai or Morghast Harbingers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: TRAVEL THE NIDUS PATHS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of a Nidus Path to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units.
When the underdog uses this ability, they can choose to set up the target wholly within 12" of any Nidus Path and more than 9" from all enemy units instead of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield.

abilities.name: ESCAPE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of the escape point in enemy territory to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective and the unit using this ability from the battlefield. That unit has escaped.

abilities.name: GRAB THE REALMSTONE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting, that you control and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of the unit using this ability and not on a terrain feature.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of the Mother Cauldron to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 1, the Mother Cauldron is destroyed. On a 2+, the target is destroyed.

abilities.name: SECURE NEW GROUND
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they contest an objective that you do not control.

abilities.name: RESERVE CONTINGENT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in the second turn force or the third turn force that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: ARRIVAL OF RESERVES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in reserve.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere wholly within friendly territory more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BACKBONE OF SUCCESS

abilities.name: LEADER OF THE PACK
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick another visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the target is LITTLE. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SUMMON AETHERVOID PENDULUM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulum on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON QUICKSILVER SWORDS

abilities.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
